# Semantic axiom pins for the EasyCrypt +C port (F5, 2026-07-16).
# Format: <name><TAB><normalized full statement>. Generated by:
#   python3 scripts/ec_axioms.py easycrypt/drafts/*.ec
# check_easycrypt.sh asserts the live extraction EQUALS this set exactly
# (toolchain-free, in the [pins] / --dry-run block). This upgrades the pin
# from 'there are 8 axioms' to 'exactly THESE 8 axioms with THESE statements',
# so deleting load-bearing good_pos + adding a benign axiom, or weakening
# dmkey_ll from 'is_lossless dmkey' to 'false', both FAIL. All 8 live in the
# two stdlib-only files FORS_C10.ec (7) + STCR_C.ec (1), so this is checkable
# with no opam switch / no MM45 toolchain.
dmkey_ll	axiom dmkey_ll : is_lossless dmkey.
dpp_ll	axiom dpp_ll : is_lossless dpp.
eqiks_g	axiom eqiks_g (x x' : int * int * int) (y : out_t) : x \in g y => x' \in g y => x.`1 = x'.`1.
good_pos	axiom good_pos (m : msg) : 0%r < mu dmkey (good m).
neqisvs_g	axiom neqisvs_g (x x' : int * int * int) (y : out_t) : x \in g y => x' \in g y => x <> x' => x.`2 <> x'.`2.
rng_g	axiom rng_g (y : out_t) (x : int * int * int) : x \in g y => 0 <= x.`3 < t.
size_g	axiom size_g (y : out_t) : size (g y) = k.
uniq_g	axiom uniq_g (y : out_t) : uniq (map (fun (x : int * int * int) => x.`2) (g y)).
